title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. purity 2203 views Q. A women aged 74 years is not having control over her urine. she passes urine in her dress without any control. Her urine comes out without any control after performing vazu. Please inform that how she has to perform namaz and other ibadats like reciting quran etc. 2644 views Q. Is it sunnah to renew the wudhu before going to bed, even if we have the wudhu of Isha salah? 2661 views Q. If a non-Mahram sees the female’s awrah, (hair, ankle or wrist), it nullifies her wudhu. Is this correct? 17142 views Q. Urgent Please respond to my question as soon as possible as i may be praying without valid ghusl and wudu. My dentist has recently fitted braces to straighten my teeth, where they will remain for 3 years, the actual brackets have been glued on to the middle of each tooth, because of this water cannot reach the area where the adhesive has been applied. As I am a married woman I am now concerned that my ghusl and wudu for prayers is not valid. Please can you advise me regarding this matter. 1. Is my wudu and ghusl still valid 2. Can I still pray and recite Quran and go for Umra etc 3. Will I have to make all my prayers Qaza for 3 years once the braces are removed I await for your speedy response 7391 views Q. Is it allowed to go for Wudu or going to toilet while Azan is given? 18285 views Q. Dog hairs in water sump 3409 views Q. Do Madhi and Wadi Have Smell? And Can You Pray Salah in Same Cloth? 22797 views Q. If we kiss our wife on cheeks and lips then it is compulsory to do ghusl please help on this matter 22072 views Q. The standing urinor (that is mounted on the wall) in which our clothes does not gets dirty by it. 2183 views Q. Reading or Reciting in Menses 27066 views Q. 1. I am facing a problem with my taharah, often I hesitate to pass urine because of this. After passing urine, I try my best to see to it that the last drop of urine is out, then wash with water, after this I walk for a short while on the place where I stand, again wash with water and come out. I use only the INDIAN toilet. After coming out I find some small drops of urine passing out, if I wash it with water, there will be a pressure to pass urine again. Because of this reasons my Prayers(Namaz) have been missing. I am really ashamed to narrate my problem personally to an AALIM, because looking at my face they would be shocked to hear such problems from me, as I ALHAMDULLIALAH have a big beard and wear Sunna'h cap always. I have a desire to become a HAFIZ E QURAN, my elders and other Buzrugs also motivate me in this, but the problem of taharah is being a hurdle for this. ALLHAMDULILLAH about 4 years back I have even lead the tarawih prayers in our masjid(in Bangalore) for the last 3 days of Ramadhan. But then for all these good things taharah is becoming a hurdle. I feel I donot know the way to achieve taharah, rather than feeling it is a problem related to my physical health. I perform WADU for every Salah, suspecting there should be a problem with my physical health(i.e Drops of urine continously passing out). I strongly feel this problem is due to lack of knowledge in achieving taharah after passing urine. I would humbly request you to guide me to get rid of this problem and pray to ALLAH that my problem of taharah is solved. Please pray for me that I become a good HAFIZ E QUARN, follow the Sharia'h properly and become a good DAEE E DEEN. I am really sorry for having written my such big problematic description. 4321 views Q. I WANT TO KNOW THAT WHEN A GIRL HAS HER PERIODS DURING RAMZAANS DEN SHE CAN READ QURAN , NAMAZ, OR CAN DO TILAWAT IN HAJ OR NOT? 2440 views Q. Is it allowed to batch without any cloth in closed bathroom? 4069 views Q. Cooking without having Ghusl 13616 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 37781 Country: India Title: If my hand is wet with water and I have held a najis clothe by that with wet hand will my hand also become najis Question: (1) If my hand is wet with water and I have held a najis clothe by that with wet hand will my hand also become najis. (2) If one has a women beauty parlor will her earning be halal? (3) If I am doing business of any halal thing example pens my manufacturing or investing cost is Rs 50. In which 25 rupees is haram and Rs 25 is halal and I am getting Rs 100 after selling in market, and earn the profit of Rs 50. Will my Rs 50 profit be halal? (4) Is listening to a song without music haram or with music or in both the conditions it is haram? (5) Is property dealing halal? My neighbour is doing property dealing. Can I take his food for eating? He is a Hindu. (6) If we are doing ghusl and when I put water mug on me the water passing from my body falls on bathroom floor and after falling on floor some water drops got in my bathing bucket from floor. Can that water be ok for ghusl? (7) My Quran alfaz is ok but many times when I pray namaz some alfaz do not come out properly due to little coughing problem. So will my salah be ok without repeating that alfaz during reading the Quran? Answer ID: 37781 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 598/507/B=1433) (1) Your hand shall not be impure. (2) The income of unlawful work which is done there its income shall be unlawful as well. (3) The profit of 50 rupees shall be halal for you. (4) It is haram to listen to the song with music. If any man is singing without music while the meaning of the song is lawful and right then there is no harm in listening to it. (5) If one does not tell a lie, does not deceive then this work is right. You can eat meal with him, provided that non-Muslim feeds you halal and pure food. (6) Yes, it shall be right. (7) You should pronounce those words correctly controlling your cough otherwise salah shall be null if the meaning is altered. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
